structs.notes: Size stays OPEN (partial). A203 found: (1) the counter/table alias inside UpdateBoneMapCache, so no flat member layout can cover both as separate members; (2) the counter is 4096 bytes (id & 0xFFF), not 2048; (3) the table lower bound 1362736 contradicts game-test 314624 and the 313792 tail closure from the note; (4) the upper bound is 2499504 because the Decoder lock at that address belongs to DecoderFrameChildPool, not to ParticleManager; IDA's 2501248 covers the Decoder globals (IDA labels them `g_particleManager._pad200048+...`) and is wrong. The counter and the table are absolute RVA displacements from the g_particleManager symbol (no this register), and no name exists at g_particleManager+562480 (names table checked), so they are not named adjacent globals; the aliasing argues against two separate objects. Child ParticleManager__Particle_SoundData stays 56 bytes (A112/A138). s_particleBoneMapBitsets (0x152C67A10) is a separate named global before this object.
